messages:
nora: Quick follow-up on the rollout-metadata RFC. I sketched a compact shape that introduces `stability_tag` and a small rollforward window to help automated routing without forcing heavy client logic. Thoughts?

diego: Paste the example so runtime folks can eyeball the fast-path fields.

nora: Example below. Key ideas: stability_tag groups compatible releases, rollforward_window lets runtime try newer candidates for a short time before falling back, stamp_seq for cache invalidation.

```json
{
  \"artifact_id\": \"auth-decoder-6b\",
  \"stamp\": \"v2026-04-12\",
  \"stamp_seq\": 12,
  \"stability_tag\": \"stable-qualifier:A\",
  \"candidates\": [
    {\"type\": \"hash\", \"id\": \"sha256:1111aa\", \"variant\": \"fp16\", \"priority\": 0},
    {\"type\": \"stamp\", \"id\": \"v2026-04-10\", \"variant\": \"int8\", \"priority\": 1}
  ],
  \"rollforward_window_seconds\": 300,
  \"fallback_policy\": \"stability_first\",
  \"soft_expiry\": \"2026-09-01T00:00:00Z\",
  \"runtime_annotations\": [\"placement:prefer-short-seq\"]
}
```

nora: Notes: `stability_tag` is a light-weight label control-plane can use to prefer candidates that share a compatibility surface. `rollforward_window_seconds` allows runtime to optimistically try higher-priority candidates published recently (useful during canaries).

kai: Two things: (1) define semantics for `stability_first` 1) does it prefer same-tag even if higher latency? (2) how do clients detect that a stamp was reordered? stamp_seq covers that, but we should add a small guidance on client cache TTL.

diego: For (1) we should make `fallback_policy` explicit options: `stability_first`, `latency_first`, `cost_first`. Document that in appendix. For (2) propose clients re-resolve when control-plane seq > local or after a neutral TTL (default 60s).

infra-bot: schema-lint: validator warns if rollforward_window_seconds > 86400; recommended max 3600. Opening ticket INF-5550 to align validator and appendix.

nora: Good call. We'll cap at 3600 in appendix. Also add `stamp_origin` for telemetry (user_rollout/canary/auto-migrate).

kai: Operational note: Dedicated tenants might set `pin_policy.hard=true` in tenant_overrides; mention precedence of tenant overrides in doc.

diego: Action items: nora will update appendix with `stability_tag` semantics, rollforward caps, and validator note (ETA EOD). kai will write client cache TTL guidance (ETA tomorrow). I'll wire INF-5550 into schema tests (ETA 2 days).

nora: If no objections I'll merge the appendix after updates. :+1:

infra-bot: INF-5550 tracked. Re-run schema tests after merge.

kai: Nice and small, keeps clients cheap.
